visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A pair of hands is shown in a bright kitchen setting, holding a small glass jar filled with whole white peppercorns in front of a white electric spice grinder. The lighting is bright and even. (2) The hand pours the white peppercorns into the stainless steel inner bowl of the white grinder. The background shows a wooden table and a blurred kitchen environment. (3) The hand places a clear plastic lid onto the grinder and presses down on the top button to start the grinding process. (4) The grinder is pulsed in short bursts, visible through the slight vibration of the machine and the hand's finger movements on the button. (5) The hand then presses and holds the button for a continuous, finer grind. (6) After grinding, the hand lifts the lid and taps the top and sides of the grinder lid with a flat palm to release any trapped powder. (7) The lid is removed, revealing fine, greyish-white pepper powder inside the metal bowl. (8) A small metal spoon is used to scoop the freshly ground powder from the bowl into a clean glass storage jar. (9) The hand uses a finger to wipe the remaining fine powder from the inner rim of the stainless steel bowl into the jar. (10) The grinder bowl is inverted over the glass jar and tapped to ensure all contents are transferred. (11) A close-up shows the jar filled with the ground pepper, and a spoon scoops some up to display the fine, consistent texture. (12) The scene shifts to show another jar containing red chili flakes, which is opened and scooped to show its contents. (13) Another small jar with tan-colored five-spice powder is shown being scooped. (14) The hand uses a small white brush to sweep out the remaining residue from the grinder bowl. (15) A piece of white paper towel is used to wipe the inside of the bowl clean. (16) The hand removes a clear silicone ring from the underside of the plastic lid, demonstrating how to disassemble it for cleaning.
